evidence.title: Getting started — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Free Apple-Silicon Mac client bundles server. Projects can be any folder; provider CLI accounts are separate.

evidence.title: How Unpeel runs — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Rust Host owns detached PTY sessions and clients only attach; server/worker restarts can preserve sessions, but machine reboot cannot.

evidence.title: Supported agents — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Named CLI runtime launch, hooks, transcript and resume support differ; Pi uses output heuristics and MCP support is provider-specific.

evidence.title: Agent runtimes — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Managed launches bind provider conversation identity; merely observing a CLI in a blank terminal does not grant safe resume or transcript access.

evidence.title: CLI reference — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Product CLI creates, inspects, sends, waits and controls sessions; serve install configures a per-user launchd/systemd service.

evidence.title: Headless Host — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Same server runs on an owned Mac/Linux host with service-manager setup and phone/Mac clients; full cloud-machine matrix remains under validation.

evidence.title: Workspaces — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Local, SSH and paired workspaces retain sessions/data on the owning host; additional local workspaces are experimental.

evidence.title: Git worktrees — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Optional worktrees are off by default and create child projects; agent worktree preparation requires an additional grant.

evidence.title: Remote workspaces — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Direct, SSH and Link open the same Host; supported remote actions are capability-advertised.

evidence.title: Unpeel Link — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Link is optional operated encrypted relay and push; service does not store session content and host must remain reachable.

evidence.title: Overview — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: One session-scoped MCP server provides browser, peer sessions, runtimes, workspace setup and artifacts; grants control visibility and use.

evidence.title: Sessions — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Docs describe peer reads and directional write approval, but say agents cannot create/close sessions; this conflicts with newer 0.7.5 release notes.

evidence.title: Agents — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Recognized runtime occurrences can be listed, read and waited on; stale occurrence references are rejected.

evidence.title: Session gallery — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Session gallery shows browser captures/downloads and user images; phone markup/attachment and Host-dependent write parity are documented. Video is not supported yet.

evidence.title: Sessions & terminals — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Provider conversation resume differs from PTY survival; precise IDs or provider-specific fallbacks are used, and ambiguous process ownership refuses replacement.

evidence.title: Activity & the menu bar — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Busy/done/needs-you states use provider hooks or output heuristics with explicit limits; status survives app restart.

evidence.title: Overview — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Standalone terminal plugins can be surfaced as sessions/companions; widget rail is roadmap work, not current UI.

evidence.title: Projects & presets — Unpeel Docs
evidence.finding: Users manage launch presets and project folders; arbitrary commands remain supported.

evidence.title: Terms of service — Unpeel
evidence.finding: Mac application is free without trial/account/license; Link is $59 per Host seat yearly. Terms prohibit redistribution of modified app builds.

evidence.title: Privacy policy — Unpeel
evidence.finding: No behavioral analytics; anonymous update records persist. Terminal UI can disable update checks with UNPEEL_NO_UPDATE. Relay cannot decrypt content; push carries bounded metadata.
